notes.title: Roadmap 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36649981/2c3cf343ef1832d283bfdf6abef977c46da3c6f4.jpg[/img]

[b]2021 ROADMAP[/b]

[b]Resuscitation:[/b]
New animations for the main character and enemies.
Major gameplay improvements.
Combat system overhaul to make it more fun and modern.

[b]Revolution:[/b]
New enemies and gameplay features.
Difficulty rebalance.
Additional optimization for pastgen PCs.

[b]Restoration:[/b]
A complete rebuilding of starting levels based on the community's feedback.
Rolling out new story content.

notes.title: 🤖Prologue Out Now! - Try Orange Cast on Steam🤖
notes.notes:
Comrades!

[h3][b]Big news: the Prologue to Orange Cast is available now![/b][/h3]

If you're a big fan of Sci-Fi Space Action games you will like what we have!
[b]Prologue to Orange Cast[/b] is an atmospheric adventure in a large-scale setting where Soviet and Western science fiction are combined itself.

We decided to make our demo permanently available to download and play, and we hope this will give everyone the chance to try out the game and get a feel for what it is like, so… give us your thoughts about it, will ya?!😉

Cheers
Valkyrie Initiative
